name: Iterative Ray Marching with Neural Volume Inference
definition: An iterative ray marching algorithm that splits the rendering of a neural volume into multiple passes (iterations) to handle rays that do not fully converge (alpha < 1) in a single pass. It uses a counter-based compaction mechanism to track active rays between kernel launches.
summary: Iterative Ray Marching with Neural Volume Inference is a CUDA rendering method that decouples neural inference from shading to process unconverged rays across multiple kernel launches.
